question: Bleaching powder is produced by the action of chlorine on:

• This process forms bleaching powder, **which is commonly used as a disinfectant and bleaching age**nt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bleaching powder is formed from lime and chlorine. 
 
• It is formed by the action of chlorine on extinguished lime.
 
• It is used in making chloroform and chlorine gas.
 
• Another use of bleaching powder is to disinfect water.
